title: Agent Firehose event envelope
description: The normalized envelope every capture source is mapped into before display, persistence, or export. Spool files and exports are NDJSON: one envelope per line. Consumers MUST ignore unknown fields so the schema can grow additively.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version, stamped at spool-append time. Absent on spool lines written before versioning existed; readers treat absent/0 as version 1.

id.description: Random 16-byte hex identifier, unique per event.

source_time.description: Timestamp supplied by the observed source, when one exists. Added additively within schema version 1.

capture_time.description: Timestamp when Agent Firehose observed the event. Added additively within schema version 1.

source.description: Agent family that produced the event.

agent.description: Specific agent or binary name within the source family.

session_id.description: Stable identifier grouping events of one agent session.

trace_id.description: Identifier grouping causally related events, possibly across sessions. Present only when the source supplies one; adapters preserve it verbatim.

turn_id.description: Source-native identifier grouping events within one agent turn. Present only when the source supplies one; adapters preserve it verbatim. Added additively within schema version 1.

prompt_id.description: Source-native prompt or interaction correlation identifier. Present only when the source supplies one; adapters preserve it verbatim. Added additively within schema version 1.

call_id.description: Source-native tool/command correlation id (e.g. a Codex call_id or Claude Code tool_use_id). Present only when the source supplies one; adapters preserve it verbatim. Added additively within schema version 1.

category.description: Canonical classification used for display grouping and filtering.

name.description: Source-specific event name, e.g. a hook or bus event name.

repo.description: Repository name the activity happened in, when known.

cwd.description: Working directory of the agent, when known.

repo_id.description: Canonical local path of the Git common directory, identifying one repository across linked worktrees when observable. Added additively within schema version 1.

worktree_id.description: Canonical local path of the containing Git worktree root when observable. Added additively within schema version 1.

payload.description: Source-specific structured details. Subject to privacy-mode redaction: values may be truncated strings (balanced) or {sha256, len} digests (minimal).

raw.description: Original source payload. Present only in full privacy mode.
